note: Research proposals for human review. Not approved records. Do not publish.

proposals.conditions: SADC member state citizens.
proposals.evidence: Section 6: nationals of "SADC Member States except Comoros" are not required to have a visa to enter Tanzania; the Kuala Lumpur High Commission lists Zimbabwe as not requiring a visa
proposals.conflicts: The Windhoek and Kigali High Commission lists of countries not requiring a visa do not include Zimbabwe. Those lists are undated and appear older.
proposals.reviewerNotes: Resolve with the Immigration Services Department (info@immigration.go.tz) or a dated notice before approval. No stay period is stated.

proposals.conditions: Eligible for both the online visa and the visa on arrival (ordinary visa USD 50).
proposals.evidence: Section 7, "Countries whose nationals can obtain a visa upon arrival", names Nigeria
proposals.conflicts: Section 6 of the same document exempts Commonwealth countries (except the UK, Canada, India, Pakistan, Australia and New Zealand) from visas, and Nigeria is a Commonwealth member. None of the three High Commission no-visa lists we read includes Nigeria, which is consistent with section 7.
proposals.reviewerNotes: Section 7 names Nigeria explicitly; section 6 is a group rule. Prefer the explicit listing only after confirming with the department.

proposals.conditions: Eligible for both the online visa and the visa on arrival (ordinary visa USD 50).
proposals.evidence: Section 7, "Countries whose nationals can obtain a visa upon arrival", names Ghana
proposals.conflicts: Section 6 of the same document exempts Commonwealth countries, which includes Ghana, and all three High Commission lists we read name Ghana as not requiring a visa. data.ts currently publishes Ghana → Tanzania as visa-free.
proposals.reviewerNotes: Do not change the published record until the department confirms. If confirmed, the published record should move to disputed, then be superseded.

proposals.conditions: Visa or prior authorization required before departure; apply on the Malawi e-Visa portal. Not eligible for visa on arrival.
proposals.evidence: Listed under "Category One countries: countries and regions that require a visa well in advance, or prior authorization"
proposals.reviewerNotes: Category follows the dataset's convention for advance online clearance (see zm-prior, zw-cat-c). Notice effective 24 February 2026.

proposals.conditions: Visa-exempt for tourism and business; apply for an Electronic Travel Authorisation at evisa.gov.mz before travel. Renewable for a further 30 days on justification.
proposals.evidence: Ghana is listed as visa-exempt "for a 30-day stay (renewable for an additional 30 days upon justification)"; exempt nationals must apply for prior authorization at evisa.gov.mz
proposals.reviewerNotes: Embassy source. Confirm on the SENAMI e-visa portal (evisa.gov.mz) if it becomes readable.
